magmaw_parasite_containment_failure.invariant: exactly the fixed Fire Mage and Marksman Hunter team owns parasite targeting, threat, damage, and stable lane movement through final native path admission while every other player remains outside infection range and suppresses parasite-reaching area damage

magmaw_parasite_control_allows_player_in.invariant: the fixed mobile bait team must traverse a stable room lane whose complete and incomplete movement requests reach a newly proved safe native endpoint without player Parasitic Infection or parasite re-entry

magmaw_lethal_movement_identity_churn.invariant: one Magmaw Crash or Pillar escape retains one safe destination and candidate identity across blackboard revisions and movement-lease expiry until measured same-floor arrival, while re-entry into the same persistent hazard opens a new escape episode

magmaw_lethal_movement_safe_completion_m.invariant: a retained Magmaw Crash or Pillar escape completes when measured same-floor movement places the actor outside the lethal envelope, even when the native planner selects a shorter bounded endpoint than the original radial request; later ticks cannot retry an off-navmesh endpoint for the completed episode

stationary_combat_masks_movement_nonprog.invariant: movement progress timestamps advance only after measured actor displacement; combat, casting, candidate submission, and retained movement ownership cannot hide a stationary movement stall

movement_receipt_terminal_join_eviction.invariant: one complete Hazard retry selected after an incomplete same-actor same-intent path remains in the bounded publication until its actor, intent fingerprint, planner result, native launch, spline progress, and terminal outcome or explicit supersession are joined

chainwielder_future_drudge_contamination.invariant: generation-3 Drudges cannot contact the generation-2 Chainwielder pull

chainwielder_receiptless_hazard_rejectio.invariant: a receiptless pre-admission Hazard intent rejected by the future-pack destination guard remains an observation owned by that rejected producer and cannot clear or overwrite an already-admitted Route native path or an armed route-owned hazard-retry lifecycle

current_route_combat_authority_preempted.invariant: while an exact current-node target or persisted pack member is alive and attackable, current-node authority is reconstructed before stale anchors, regroup, retreat, previous or future targets, and generic fallback can own the tick
current_route_combat_authority_preempted.counting_note: Eight retained pre-ledger route-authority failures, Canary102 through its child signature, and Canary114 establish ten lifetime occurrences. Stage labels remain evidence under this parent invariant.

same_level_encounter_hazard_path_rejecti.invariant: short same-floor hazard movement cannot be rejected by an unrelated lower map floor or a globally strict endpoint tolerance when a bounded progressive native endpoint is complete and locally floor-valid

same_level_movement_path_floor_false_neg.invariant: a valid same-floor native movement must use one owner-independent floor proof and bounded progressive segmentation instead of rejecting the request from an unrelated sampled floor
same_level_movement_path_floor_false_neg.counting_note: The ledger records the recent gate-bearing occurrences. Older retained reports plus Canary122 establish sixteen unique runs under this parent invariant.

same_level_native_endpoint_z_normalizati.invariant: a complete floor-valid native path that preserves the requested horizontal endpoint may normalize Z within the native point-floor tolerance without becoming an endpoint mismatch

same_level_native_path_proof_false_negat.invariant: complete floor-valid native paths and deterministic shorter retries of incomplete same-level hazard paths must be admitted by one owner-independent proof that distinguishes bounded endpoint identity, native floor normalization, and diagnostic floor observations

native_planner_executor_launch_divergenc.invariant: native movement execution must launch the planner-proved path controls or fail closed after validating the launched spline against the same path and floor proof before movement can contaminate live actor position

magmaw_prepot_geometry_conflicts_with_ba.invariant: durable setup precedes encounter formation, every admitted member then uses its native pre-pot at the declared formation including max-range baiters, and the designated tank pulls before the short aura expires

raid_partial_wipe_waits_for_last_survivo.invariant: partial deaths wait while a native boss encounter remains active, but after an authoritative native reset with no combat or engaged hostiles dead members may begin ordinary release and corpse-run recovery without killing or teleporting survivors

phase1_capture_duplicate_autostart_lifec.invariant: a preparation-only handoff disables worldserver AutoStart and the phase-1 capture controller is the sole owner of the explicit botauto start command

deferred_candidate_dangling_reference_ca.invariant: every deferred Candidate::Attempt explicitly owns copied values and borrows only state whose lifetime spans Kernel::Resolve; submitter stack locals are never retained by blanket reference capture

native_partial_death_recovery_lifecycle_.invariant: after an authoritative native reset, every dead member must complete ordinary release, measurable corpse-run movement, entrance worldport, reclaim, full-roster rejoin, and only then route advancement; a submitted or retained movement object is never progress evidence by itself
native_partial_death_recovery_lifecycle_.counting_note: Ten retained failures span reset admission, cross-map movement, trigger/reclaim, and rejoin. Canary97 is retained separately as one nondeterministic success on the same binary as failed Canary98 and does not close the family.

nine of ten players took Parasitic Infection or Infectious Vomit; 63 partial-path and 29 floor-gap mechanic moves were rejected; Magmaw not killed
Preparation-only config enabled AutoStart while the capture controller also issued botauto start; attempt 1 was torn down, attempt 2 reprovisioned, and worldserver exited -11 before gameplay.

Exactly one botauto start and one attempt reached Kernel::Resolve, then SIGSEGV occurred in the deferred fallback combat lambda. GDB proved a submitter-local helper and route flag were retained through blanket reference capture after the submitter returned.
Two dead tanks could not begin recovery while eight survivors waited at the reset Drudge pack.
The released mage moved about seven yards in 123 seconds because the same path was repeatedly restarted.

Chainwielder and both Drudges died. Two DPS ghosts retained accepted Recovery paths while remaining exactly at the Burning Steppes graveyard; one repath then terminal native_runback_no_progress prevented Magmaw reach.
The Magmaw node had no explicit Drakonid prerequisite authority, so generic selection repeatedly pulled prior corridor trash.
The current Chainwielder pack contained only GUID 27 while 349 actions selected future Drudges and current profiles lost usable authority.
Alive exact Drudges were retired from target authority and could not be reacquired.
A generic per-bot safe-memory anchor displaced the exact live Drudge pack and split the cohort.
Generic partial-wipe retreat preempted an alive attackable current-generation Drudge pack.
Future Magmaw targets and splash escaped current Drudge authority.
Magmaw entered combat while the current route still owned two alive Drudges.
Future-encounter offense escaped current route authority through non-player action owners.

An alive attackable tank-owned Chainwielder remained at 99.6375% HP after generic non-tank regroup cleared the exact current target; future Magmaw fallback was rejected but current-pack authority was never restored.

Chainwielder and both Drudges cleared with zero deaths. Magmaw formation then repeated successful submissions without state progress; complete floor-valid paths for GUIDs 30007 and 30010 were rejected solely because current-position Z differed 1.6441 yards from the normalized endpoint, so no member became pre-pot eligible.

The revision-3 arrived-state boundary returned no destination for the still-living same wave, so fixed-lane ownership was not continuous and the raid wiped.

All trash cleared with zero deaths and every member consumed native flask, food, and pre-pot. During Magmaw, same-room hazard requests around Z 211 repeatedly sampled unrelated floors around Z -90 to -112, preventing bounded parasite and crash movement. Fourteen direct infections reached five players; two members died before the repeated-decision watchdog stopped the still-active encounter.

The first Magmaw failure was a complete same-level parasite-contact path rejected for 2.571 yards of endpoint error; infection began 10.6 seconds later. The run recorded 100 Parasitic Infection events across eight players and Infectious Vomit reached all ten while the raid remained alive and dealt 88,260.582 active DPS.

The remaining two shared Hazard lifecycle boundaries stay pending.

Chainwielder and Drudges cleared. Hazard receipt 579 retained its complete planner, launch, progress, and selected_endpoint_reached lifecycle. For Massive Crash, actor 30007 used the original Z 210 request despite a low diagnostic floor sample, launched through a bounded complete endpoint at trace sequence 626 and receipt 509, and reached 12.064634 yards from the inferred stationary Crash source. The encounter transition failed to retire. When the actor later re-entered to 10.731111 yards, it reused the stale identity and destination and produced INCOMPLETE|FARFROMPOLY_END at receipt 636 instead of opening a new escape episode. The shared floor and native-proof hypotheses are refuted; semantic safe completion is the first broken edge.

The sealed native-path replay stopped before hazard submission. Actor 30007 at Z 193.126999 requested the connected upper-room staging point at Z 210.098007, but the request-level GetHeight probe resolved unrelated lower geometry at Z -106.245819. The planner rejected target_z_transition before PathGenerator, MotionMaster, or physical movement. This is a new adjacent variant of the shared target-floor false-negative family; the two Hazard production boundaries remain not exercised.
